selected_work: R88 F19 descriptor-level D3D9 FVF blend-weight/index input-layout semantics with hosted deterministic smoke coverage.
summary: Extended the conservative FVF input-layout translator to cover XYZB1..XYZB5 blend weights and LASTBETA_UBYTE4/LASTBETA_D3DCOLOR blend-index encodings. XYZB1..4 map blend weights to matching float component formats; XYZB5 splits five float weights across BLENDWEIGHT0 float4 and BLENDWEIGHT1 float1. LASTBETA_UBYTE4 maps the last beta slot to BLENDINDICES R8G8B8A8_UINT; LASTBETA_D3DCOLOR maps it to BLENDINDICES B8G8R8A8_UNORM. Blend-position FVF can now carry NORMAL at the correct post-beta offset. Conflicting LASTBETA encodings, LASTBETA on non-blend position encodings and insufficient stride remain fail-closed. A dedicated hosted Win32 smoke executable verifies supported and fail-closed cases. No native shader binding or draw routing was enabled.
evidence: CONVERSION-DX11-00032 completed broader F20 deterministic semantic coverage and selected the remaining F19 blend-weight/index FVF gap as the preferred next runtime-independent activation prerequisite.

changes.result: Updated FVF input-layout contract to include R88 blend-weight and LASTBETA index descriptor semantics while keeping F21 shader compatibility separate.
Added XYZB1..XYZB5 blend-weight descriptor generation, UBYTE4/D3DCOLOR BLENDINDICES handling, blend-position NORMAL support, and fail-closed invalid combination handling.
Added deterministic hosted R88 semantic smoke for blend weights, split XYZB5 weights, UBYTE4/D3DCOLOR indices, NORMAL offsets, dual-LASTBETA/nonblend-LASTBETA/short-stride failures.
Added dx11_input_layout_semantics executable to cmkr source-of-truth graph.
Added checked-in generated CMake target for the R88 semantic smoke.
Builds and runs the R88 input-layout semantic smoke after the existing fixed-function semantic smoke.
Added structural guards for R88 FVF blend translations, smoke cases, CMake target presence, and Backend Conversion Gate execution.

supported: D3DFVF_XYZB4 | D3DFVF_NORMAL -> POSITION + BLENDWEIGHT0 float4 + NORMAL at offset 28
D3DFVF_XYZB3 | D3DFVF_LASTBETA_UBYTE4 -> two float weights + BLENDINDICES R8G8B8A8_UINT
D3DFVF_XYZB2 | D3DFVF_LASTBETA_D3DCOLOR -> one float weight + BLENDINDICES B8G8R8A8_UNORM
D3DFVF_XYZB1 | D3DFVF_LASTBETA_UBYTE4 -> index-only beta slot with no explicit blend-weight element
fail_closed: LASTBETA index encoding on non-blend D3DFVF_XYZ position

activation_gate.reason: R88 proves descriptor-level F19 input-layout semantics for the selected FVF blend-weight/index encodings only. Shader-signature/F21 semantics, native shader/input-layout binding, live D3D11 resource mirrors, GPU execution and exact-build Quest3/VDXR parity remain unproven.

next_action: Keep NativeDrawPathActivationAllowed=false and shaderTranslationExact=false. F19 descriptor-level coverage is stronger; the next bounded runtime-independent DX11 task should add hosted shader-signature/input-contract semantics for the newly supported BLENDWEIGHT/BLENDINDICES layouts or choose another open activation prerequisite. Do not combine that with native draw promotion; F21 programmable translation and exact-build Quest3/VDXR runtime parity remain separate gates.
